title: Participation Power and rewards math
lead: Technical details moved from the public how-it-works page. Values marked provisional may change before mainnet.

items.title: Participation Power
items.text: A non-transferable weight that sets your share of future Community Pool distributions from PPL network fees. It is not a tradable token.

items.title: PowerCap and epochs
items.text: Participation is measured over epochs with diminishing returns and a hard cap per person so one account cannot absorb the whole pool.

items.title: Dynamic Participant Pool
items.text: The share of fees routed to the Community Pool (25% of eligible protocol fees) funds epoch rewards for eligible active participants.

items.title: Anti-Sybil safeguards
items.text: New accounts ramp slowly, inactive accounts decay, and caps limit how much a cluster of fake identities can earn.

items.title: Zero-Pool invariant
items.text: If no one qualifies in an epoch, undistributed Community Pool amounts are not invented as passive income — accounting stays consistent with protocol rules.

title: Technology and invariants
lead: How the network is structured — without status labels on the marketing pages.

items.title: Consensus and validators
items.text: Dedicated validators produce and attest blocks. Phones and browser tabs are participants, not validators by default.

items.title: State and storage
items.text: Nodes persist chain state locally. Historical blocks may be pruned on ordinary nodes; restarting validators rely on their own data directory.

items.title: Protocol invariants
items.text: Fee splits, supply rules, and accounting paths are enforced in protocol code — not by marketing copy.

title: Roadmap phases
lead: High-level phases for the product — not a mainnet launch date.

items.title: Current · public testnet
items.text: Wallet, token factory, trading on test PPL, and fee routing you can try today.

items.title: Next · human network
items.text: Phone participation sessions, humanity checks, and participation points — design in progress.

items.title: Later · consumer apps
items.text: Hub experiences and creator tools built on the same protocol — after core participation is proven.

title: PPL — the native asset
lead: People (PPL) pays network fees and protocol operations on this chain.

items.title: Test coins
items.text: Testnet PPL is for trying the network. Holding test PPL is not proof of profit.

items.title: Fees only in PPL
items.text: Transfers, token create, NFT mint, and contract gas are quoted in PPL on public surfaces.
